Run Config

Source

Where to clone the repo. If empty, uses /tmp/shinka_workspaces/

Worktree Isolation

Runs evolution in a separate working directory so your original folder is never modified.
What does this do?
  • Clean local git repo → create a fast git worktree from a cached bare clone in /tmp/shinka_workspaces.
  • Dirty git repo or non‑git folder → snapshot copy into the run’s results/.../workspace, preserving uncommitted changes.
  • Your source folder is never edited.
Override local isolation strategy…
Only applies for Local Path sources that are git repos.
